Angela

The chicken seller tied to the coop mission, bird pickup and the correct coop climate equipment.

  • Current players identify Angela as the chicken seller used by the coop mission. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · August 2026 animal support answers and community scan · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Purchased chickens appear in the fenced field behind her house rather than in the player's inventory; carry them or load them into a car boot. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Chicken coop mission · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Official support context identifies Angela's coop/barn heater and AC as the functional versions; City Hall decoration units do not work for animal housing. Official

    Source: August 2026 animal support answers and community scan · local archive · Build: 0.8.10.x

Gigi

The NPC at the center of the current large-egg quest and its police-chase return route.

  • An official moderator reply identifies the two-egg hand-in as the end of the main questline for now; this does not catalogue optional or unrelated quests. Official

    Source: Steam thread: official reply on the current main quest endpoint · Build: null

  • The current quest route asks for two Large Eggs before the next handoff becomes available. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence quest route · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • After the egg handoff, Gigi follows the player through a police escape and must be returned to her home area to finish the documented route. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam thread: Real Eggs, Real Evidence quest route · Build: 0.8.10.x

  • Multiple current players report no implemented follow-up quest after this route; treat it as the present story endpoint, not a hidden trigger with a known solution. Community-confirmed

    Source: Steam threads: current quest line after Gigi · Build: 0.8.10.x
